name: Zamayirha Peter
title: Zamayirha Peter — Stories that move people
description: Communications consultant, multimedia journalist, speaker and moderator. Meet Zamayirha Peter and explore storytelling with purpose.

hero.description: A storyteller with purpose. A voice for impact.
hero.alt: Black and white studio portrait of Zamayirha Peter looking towards the camera.

about.label: The person behind the perspective
about.heading: Good stories connect us. Great ones move us.
about.intro: I’m Zamayirha. A communications consultant, multimedia journalist, speaker and moderator with a belief in the power of a well-told story.
about.body: From the newsroom to conversations with global leaders, my work brings people, ideas and purpose together. I partner with individuals and organisations to communicate clearly, build meaningful connections and advance their impact.
about.alt: Zamayirha Peter in a black off-the-shoulder outfit in a studio portrait.

work.heading:
People first.
Always.
work.intro: The most meaningful work starts with listening. To the voices shaping our culture. To the people building our communities. To the stories still waiting to be heard.

items.title: Making room for stories that matter.
items.description: Interviews and conversations with artists, public figures and changemakers.
items.alt: Zamayirha Peter smiling alongside two guests.

items.title: Meeting people where their stories begin.
items.description: A people-centred approach to journalism and development communications.
items.alt: Zamayirha Peter in conversation with two people wearing high-visibility workwear at a work site.

services.title: Strategic communications
services.summary: Clarity for your brand. Purpose in every message.
services.body: Communications, media and public relations support for organisations and individual brands. An approach grounded in authentic stories and the people you want to reach.

services.title: Multimedia journalism
services.summary: Human stories. Thoughtful questions. Fresh perspective.
services.body: Print, digital and broadcast experience, with contributions to publications including City Press and HuffPost. Reporting and conversations that put people at the centre.

services.title: Speaking & moderation
services.body: Speaking and moderation on leadership, purpose, education and personal branding. Bringing thoughtful questions and a human perspective to the room.

services.title: Purpose & mentorship
services.summary: Because your story shouldn’t end with you.
services.body: Through Ideas That Walk, Zamayirha connects leadership, learning and social impact. Sharing knowledge and experience to encourage the people who come next.

quote: This mountain has been assigned to you to show others it can be moved.
